## The Swedish Bird Inventory (Svensk Fågeltaxering) <br> -- Exploring trends of farm- and woodland bird species --

This website contains an exercise to analyze the data of the Swedish Bird Inventory (Svensk Fågeltaxering). Furthermore, we explore the use of population trends derived from national survey programs.

Submit your assignment in HTML format. Either use Rmarkdown (preferred) or use the *compile report*-function in RStudio. Your report should contain your R-script and your answers to the questions! In case you are not familiar with Rmarkdown you can find a very short introduction [here](https://clausrueffler.github.io/CodingWithR/Markdown.html).

**Enjoy!**

Claus & Bob
